Total on-balance-sheet commercial deposits were **$23.58B at 30 Sep 2026**, almost unchanged from $23.61B at 30 Apr 2026 (−$34M, −0.15%). Middle Market is the only segment that grew. Commercial Real Estate is shrinking the fastest, and Large Corporate, Public Sector and Business Banking are down slightly.

**Month-end balances by client segment ($M, on-balance-sheet)**

| Segment | Apr-26 | May-26 | Jun-26 | Jul-26 | Aug-26 | Sep-26 | Change Apr→Sep | % | Trend |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Large Corporate (LC) | 16,949.6 | 16,938.5 | 16,753.2 | 16,773.5 | 16,721.1 | 16,710.5 | −239.2 | −1.4% | Shrinking |
| Middle Market (MM) | 3,471.6 | 3,536.5 | 3,590.7 | 3,654.4 | 3,710.1 | 3,758.4 | **+286.8** | **+8.3%** | **Growing** |
| Public Sector & NFP (PUB) | 2,387.9 | 2,388.0 | 2,383.7 | 2,360.9 | 2,360.7 | 2,358.1 | −29.9 | −1.3% | Shrinking slightly |
| Commercial Real Estate (CRE) | 585.4 | 576.9 | 567.5 | 556.6 | 545.8 | 536.6 | **−48.8** | **−8.3%** | **Shrinking** |
| Business Banking (BB) | 218.2 | 217.2 | 216.7 | 216.7 | 215.8 | 215.0 | −3.2 | −1.5% | Shrinking slightly |
| **Total** | **23,612.9** | **23,657.1** | **23,511.8** | **23,562.1** | **23,553.6** | **23,578.7** | **−34.2** | **−0.15%** | Flat |

**Growing or shrinking:**
- **Middle Market is growing.** It rose every month, by $48M to $65M each time. Its share of total balances went from 14.7% to 15.9%. This happened even though its account count fell from 812 to 801, so the growth comes from bigger balances in existing accounts, not new accounts.
- **Commercial Real Estate is shrinking steadily.** It fell every month, by about $9M to $11M each time, for an 8.3% drop. This is the clearest outflow trend.
- **Large Corporate is down $239M (−1.4%).** About $185M of that came in June alone, when the account count went from 510 to 506. Since then it has been roughly flat. Because it is 71% of the book, its June drop wiped out most of Middle Market's gain.
- **Public Sector & NFP is down 1.3%.** Most of that is a single $23M drop in July. **Business Banking** is drifting down slowly (−1.5%).
- **Account counts fell in every segment:** 2,620 accounts in total in April, 2,587 in September.

**Sources and definitions**
- I used the reporting table of month-end on-balance-sheet deposits by segment (`BANK_DEMO.MART.DEP_BAL_SEG_MTH`). I rebuilt the six months from the account-level data (deposit accounts, monthly balances, client segment and product codes), and the numbers matched exactly for every segment and month, including account counts.
- "Commercial deposits" means the on-balance-sheet products: checking (DDA), money market (MMDA) and CDs. **Off-balance-sheet investment sweeps (SWP) are excluded.** For reference, sweeps were about $7.9B for Large Corporate and $1.8B for Middle Market at September. The older reporting table (`MART.DEP_BAL_SEG_MTH_OLD`) includes sweeps, so its Large Corporate and Middle Market totals are higher. I didn't use it.
- The last six month-ends are 30 Apr to 30 Sep 2026. Changes are measured from the April month-end to the September month-end.

**Assumptions:** Clients are grouped by the segment on their record today. The data has no segment history, so a client that changed segment during the period would show its balances under its current segment for all six months. I found no balances on accounts after they closed and no accounts without a matching client.
